evidenceBoundary: MAATAA canonical IDs/context are authoritative. Field/key/relation/lifecycle definitions below are newly authored MAATAA design proposals. NEVO SQL remains candidate-only and has not been adopted.

contracts.name: users
contracts.description: Global human or service identity. Credentials and authentication factors are deliberately outside this 13-table kernel; email normalization and identity-proof requirements need domain review.

contracts.name: user_profiles
contracts.description: Optional mutable presentation profile separated from account identity. One profile per user; locale and time-zone formats require normalization rules.

contracts.name: user_sessions
contracts.description: Server-side session metadata; store only a cryptographic token digest, never the bearer token. Digest algorithm/length, rotation, and revocation semantics require security review.

contracts.name: organisations
contracts.description: Tenant boundary for organisation-owned resources. Slug global uniqueness, closure semantics, and whether personal organisations exist are unresolved domain decisions.

contracts.name: organisation_memberships
contracts.description: Organisation access grant. Membership is deactivated by status rather than deleting history; one row per organisation/user pair means re-invitation reactivates the same record.

contracts.name: workspaces
contracts.description: Named collaboration boundary inside one organisation. Composite (id, organisation_id) key supports tenant-safe child references.

contracts.name: workspace_memberships
contracts.description: Workspace-level access grant carrying organisation_id so the workspace reference can enforce tenant-consistent membership.

contracts.name: projects
contracts.description: Project is organisation-scoped and belongs to exactly one workspace. This differs from the NEVO candidate ownership shape and requires explicit approval.

contracts.name: project_members
contracts.description: Project-to-user grant. Project membership does not imply organisation or workspace membership; authorization inheritance must be specified separately.

contracts.name: notifications
contracts.description: In-app notification addressed to one user within one organisation. Resource references are polymorphic identifiers, not foreign keys; global/platform notifications are outside this proposal.

contracts.name: evidence_items
contracts.description: Evidence metadata and immutable content locator. Content-addressing, storage URI policy, hash verification, object versioning, and retention/legal-hold behavior need explicit review.

contracts.name: approvals
contracts.description: One review request for an evidence item. Re-review creates a new row; state transitions, quorum, delegation, separation of duties, and concurrency rules remain open.

contracts.name: audit_events
contracts.description: Append-only security/audit record. Proposed FK deletion rules preserve events when projects or organisations close; actor identity may be anonymized. The `updated_at` field is proposed as insert-time parity required by the current lifecycle schema and must be reconsidered before approval.

reviewNotes: All contract, field, enum, ownership, lifecycle, constraint, relation, and index provenance remains unreviewed.
Retention references resolve to proposed policies; no retention interval or jurisdiction-specific schedule was supplied, so canonical readiness remains blocked.
NEVO remains candidate-only; mappings decisions do not promote its schema as authoritative.

completeness.meaning: CompleteDraft means all schema-contract sections have proposed values and pass structural checks. It is not approved or compiler-ready.
